text:
maya.support: Morning team — quick triage snapshot for today:
- Queue: 24 total (↑3 vs yesterday)
- P1: 1 (SSO auth failure), P2: 6, rest P3/P4
- Hot item: embeddings latency spike affecting some us-east-1 customers (03:00–04:30 UTC). We have an incident open.

maya.support: Macros: pushed a small refresh to the /support/macros repo — theres a new macro for the SSO flow and a clarification for billing duplicates. PR: https://git.company/redwood/support-macros/pull/87

maya.support: Asks:
1) Who can review the macro PR this morning?
2) Can someone pick up the auth P1 until 15:00 PST? Im out at 16:00.
3) Any quick mitigations for the embeddings spike (workarounds we can tell customers)?

alex.platform: on the macro PR — Ill review in the next hour, pinging @nora.devex for wording check.

priya.support: re: P1 auth, I already have the reproducer and logs (see below). If someone can take the live session handoff after 11:30am PT, I can do the initial contact.
priya.support: Logs snippet:
```
ERR auth|2026-03-17T16:12:03Z|token_lookup failed|user_id=...|err=token not found
```

jordan.eng: embeddings spike — looks correlated with a kernel swap on a small fraction of GPU hosts (telemetry shows longer setup times). Short-term: recommend routing affected customers to a compatible model variant or revert kernel change for the pool. I can coordinate with runtime infra.

riley.oncall: tagging in — Ill take the P1 handoff at 11:45 PT. Priya, can you drop the customer contact thread and the escalation checklist link here?

priya.support: sure, escalation checklist: https://docs.company/esc-checklist
Customer thread: https://support.company/tickets/9142 — note they included a SAML assertion screenshot.

nora.devex: will do wording pass on macro PR, quick note: add the "tested steps" bullet and a safe-suggestion for customers to clear local cookies for SSO. small grammar tweak too.

alex.platform: done a first pass on PR, left two tiny comments. If tests pass, we can merge and ship macros after a 30-min watch.

triage-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-137 — embeddings latency spike (assigned: jordan.eng, severity: S2). Logs aggregated at https://incidents.company/INC-2026-137

maya.support: timeline for today:
- 11:45 PT: P1 handoff (riley)
- 12:30 PT: macros PR merge window
- 13:00 PT: infra rollback plan if kernel revert needed

maya.support: Volunteers for afternoon surge coverage? I have to leave at 16:00 PT.

priya.support: I can cover 16:00–18:00 PT if needed (happy to stay late).

alex.platform: Im available from 15:30–17:00 PT for reviews and quick infra coordination.

jordan.eng: Ill take point on the kernel rollback plan and loop infra. Will post a short runbook update in the incident channel before the rollback window.

riley.oncall: Oncall note: if we escalate to S1, page the infra pager and @eng-sre. For now Ill monitor and handle the customer thread.

maya.support: thanks all — quick housekeeping: if youre editing macros, add an entry to the CHANGELOG.md with a one-line rationale. saves back-and-forth. :thumbsup:

nora.devex: noted — will update the macro changelog after wording pass.

alex.platform: merging the PR now (if CI green).

triage-bot: PR merged: support-macros#87 by alex.platform at 2345680010

priya.support: handing P1 to riley now — steps and contact sent.

riley.oncall: acknowledged, taking over the live thread.

maya.support: great work. If anything needs escalation ping me on DM. Standup complete.

alex.platform: thanks everyone :rocket:

jordan.eng: will update incident channel with rollback plan in ~20m.

nora.devex: quick follow-up — added the macro wording tweak and changelog entry.

maya.support: closing thread for the morning snapshot.
